subject: general
question: Which Indian institute was officially notified as an 'Institution Deemed to be University' by the Union Ministry of Education?

options.text: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune
Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), New Delhi
K R Narayanan National Institute of Visual Science and Arts, Kerala

solution:
The correct answer is __**Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Film and Television Institute of India (FTII)**, located in Pune, Maharashtra, was officially notified as an 'Institution Deemed to be University' by the Union Ministry of Education.
 
• FTII is recognized as one of India's premier institutes for learning and training in the fields of film, television, and digital media production.
 
• Established in **1960**, FTII has contributed significantly to the Indian film and television industry by producing renowned alumni such as Rajkumar Hirani, Shabana Azmi, and Naseeruddin Shah.
 
• The institute operates under the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**, Government of India, and offers a range of courses covering film direction, acting, cinematography, editing, and screenwriting.
 
• FTII's new status as a 'Deemed to be University' enables it to independently grant degrees, enhancing its academic autonomy and global recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), New Delhi:**

 
 
• IIMC is a premier institute for journalism, advertising, and public relations education under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India.
 
• Founded in 1965, the institute is renowned for its postgraduate diploma programs in English and regional journalism, advertising, public relations, and digital media.
 
 
 
• **K R Narayanan National Institute of Visual Science and Arts, Kerala:**
 
 
• Located in Kottayam, Kerala, this institute focuses on training and education in the visual and performing arts.
 
• It is named after K R Narayanan, the 10th President of India, and aims to foster innovation and creativity in the arts.
 
 
 
• **National School of Drama (NSD), Delhi:**
 
 
• NSD, established in 1959, is one of India's foremost institutions for theatre training and dramatic arts.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, and offers a three-year diploma course in dramatic arts.
